title: [Bug]: Human-in-the-loop: the docs example accepts suggested_rules, whose default is a tool-wide ALLOW, so other pending calls of the tool run unseen
body:
Thanks @iluv7, and sorry for the slow reply. You're right about the main point. Accepting
`suggested_rules` is the "always allow" choice, the same as option 2 in the Web UI or
`[a]lways` in the consol…
